تستغنوا (form X)
# تَسْتَغْنُوا (tastaḡnū) /tas.taɣ.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
# تُسْتَغْنَوْا (tustaḡnaw) /tus.taɣ.naw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
